'''Donbar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] serving in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] of [[Blackstar Squad]] in the years following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. Known to be corrupt, he committed an infraction that was reported by [[Republic trooper]] [[Larin Moxla]] serving in the same Squad. He was later dismissed from service.<ref name="FA" />
